description:
Request on ``gateway.mower.<id>.bridge.scan`` (internal, Fleet to Device-Gateway).

The gateway connects to the proxy at ``host``:``port`` with ``noise_psk``, reads its device
information and collects mower advertisements until ``expected_name`` shows up or
``timeout_s`` passes. While the gateway already holds an open link through this proxy it
answers from the live scanner instead (a re-check).

account_id.description: The mower's account as Fleet knows it.
account_id.title: Account Id

expected_name.description: The mower's Bluetooth name (its cloud device name); the scan ends early when it is seen.
expected_name.title: Expected Name

noise_psk.description: The bridge's API encryption key (`api.encryption.key` of an ESPHome bridge).
noise_psk.title: Noise Psk

title: BridgeScanRequest
